nodes.name: globals-admin.css
nodes.summary: Admin surface stylesheet using Tailwind directives and CSS custom properties to define color utilities, typography defaults, table and form styling, badge variants, and layout helpers for the ERP admin interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses @layer utilities to extend Tailwind with Cosmos design-token aliases, remapping legacy Tailwind color classes to CSS variable-backed semantic tokens for theme consistency.

nodes.name: globals-shop.css
nodes.summary: B2B shop portal stylesheet defining layout components such as the shop header, navigation, brand bar, product grid, and mobile-responsive helpers built on top of the shared global theme tokens.

nodes.name: globals-theme.css
nodes.summary: Core design-token stylesheet defining shared CSS custom properties for both the 'obsidian' (dark enterprise) and 'aurora' (light lavender) themes, including color palette, typography scale, spacing, border, and shadow tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: Themes are activated via data-theme attribute on :root, set inline in index.html before first paint to prevent FOUC. Covers obsidian and aurora theme variants with distinct color palettes.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS entry point that @imports the theme, admin, and shop stylesheets, then sets universal box-sizing, base body/html defaults, selection styling, and layout class defaults for the shop, mobile, and hub sections.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as a CSS barrel, composing globals-theme.css, globals-admin.css, and globals-shop.css via @import, making it the single stylesheet consumers (main.tsx) need to import.
